### NCF Showcase & Festival Launch

![NCF Showcase](space/stage-empty.jpeg)

TheNCF Official Launch Showcase / Opening Event for Ballina Fringe Festival 2024. Join us to celebrate theNCF new premises and launch this year's festival with an evening of incredible artistic talent!

### Programme

- **8:15** Joe Clarke (acoustic guitar and voice)
- **8:30** Jonathan Crean (sound performance)
- **8:50** Cathal Faughnan (acoustic guitar and voice)
- **9:05** Darren & Sharon (fiddle and acoustic guitar and voice)
- **9:20** Christina Henneman (poetry)
- **9:30** Errorist (acoustic guitar and voice)
- **9:45** Pembroke (acoustic guitar and voice)
